programs.title: Road absurdities 6
programs.desc: In Częstochowa we will see a tibia-shaped roundabout and a pedestrian crossing exit from the parking lot.In Ruda Śląska, we will notice a tree in the middle of the parking lot, in Katowice - an entry ban combined with bollards, and in Żory - a pedestrian crossing marked between fields.The Syrenka S201 crew will also pass the Warsaw chicane slowing down on the bend, look at the traffic lights in Bydgoszcz that have been switched off for three years and have been operational for less than a month, and consider the point of the barriers in Gawrony.There will also be plenty of Łódź absurdities - a dedicated bicycle path and a ban on entry for driving school cars.

programs.title: Road absurdities 6
programs.desc: The main road in Wrocław was closed with bollards, but drivers have already found a way around it.We will also expose the Syrenka S201 to typical Polish offroad, just outside the 30 km/h speed limit zone in Piecowice.Wołczyn will surprise us with a roundabout on the bend, Krasiejów - with the entrance to the viaduct blocked by a barrier, and Siedlce - with a tree in the middle of the road.Kamil and Krzysiek will also look at flower beds serving as a chicane in Nidzica, a half-sized "zebra" in Łódź, lanterns illuminating a ditch in Elbląg and a mysterious bicycle path in Wyszków.Finally, Kędzierzyn-Koźle and signs informing about non-existent speed bumps.
